bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to human services; providing for a grant to Boundary Waters Care Center; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; BOUNDARY WATERS CARE CENTER. +]

[+$250,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a sole-source grant to Boundary Waters Care Center in Ely, Minnesota. This is a onetime appropriation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to human services; providing for a grant to Boundary Waters Care Center; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; BOUNDARY WATERS CARE CENTER.

$250,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a sole-source grant to Boundary Waters Care Center in Ely, Minnesota. This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: $250,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a sole-source grant to Boundary Waters Care Center in Ely, Minnesota. This is a onetime appropriation.
